reason: Scoped, admin-only editor JS fix that narrows a DOM lookup from a wider wrapper to the closest '.widget-editor-body', which could break label/visibility toggling if that class isn't present in some custom themes/templates using these widget editors, but blast radius is limited to Forms admin editor UI, not runtime rendering.
